test_name: Audit and Accountability - AU-9 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Audit-Lake-025
Primary NIST family: Audit and Accountability (AU); evidence focus: AU-9.
Environment: Azure. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: audit records contain actor, source, timestamp, action, target, and outcome fields. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
